records.rationale: The query declaration is BufferHandler.Handle(string) in src/Polymorphism.cs, an implicit implementation of IHandler.Handle. Directory enumeration tooling was unavailable, so the tree was established by exhaustive targeted reads: the three inspected files form a closed compilation unit in which every referenced symbol (WorkerAlias alias, IHandler, ConsoleHandler, ConsoleSink, both partial parts of EventRecord and HandlerFactory, HandlerExtensions.Tag, BufferHandler) resolves internally, and roughly thirty probes for other plausible source filenames found no additional files. Every exact 'Handle' token in the fixture was audited. Only buffer.Handle("Cal") in PolymorphismConsumer.Run (Polymorphism.cs line 31, 0-based) has a receiver statically typed as BufferHandler and therefore semantically resolves to the queried implementation; it is the sole required usage and, being the only required location, is the deterministic definitionUsage. The interface declaration, the ConsoleHandler implementation declaration, the two interface-typed dispatch sites, and the two ConsoleHandler-typed call sites were inspected and proven to resolve to other declarations, so they are excluded. C# has no import/re-export binding token for a method under the bindings_optional policy, so no optional locations exist. All lines are ASCII, so UTF-16 character offsets equal byte offsets.
